aboutPage.title: About Murmur
aboutPage.body: Murmur is a local-first voice dictation app built on Tauri 2, whisper.cpp, and cpal. Dictation, meeting transcription, history, vocabulary, and corrections stay on this Mac. Network access is limited to model downloads and links you choose to open. Automatic updates are off; new versions are published on GitHub Releases.

historyPage.notice: Completed dictations Murmur saved, newest first. If one didn't land in your intended field, copy it here or use {copy} in the menu bar, then paste it yourself. Set a retention window in {settings} if you want old entries to expire automatically.

homePage.aiTip: Copy for AI puts your AI handoff prompt and the selected meeting’s transcript on your clipboard. Paste it into an AI assistant for a summary; Murmur does not send it. If you paste it into another service, that service receives it.

supportDiagnostics.title: Support diagnostics
supportDiagnostics.description: Preview the exact content before copying it. This report excludes transcripts, audio, titles, device labels, clipboard contents, URLs, and file paths. Murmur never uploads it automatically. If you report a bug, preview and copy this report, review it, and paste only what you want to share. Public issue reports are visible to everyone.

generalSettings.hotkeyHelp: Hold to record while pressed. Double-tap to lock recording on; tap again to stop. Press and hold the combination you want, then release.
generalSettings.themeHelp: Follow the system, or force light or dark across the app.
generalSettings.shellHelp: Choose the color atmosphere behind the sidebar and title bar.
generalSettings.loginHelp: Start Murmur automatically when you log in.
generalSettings.updateHelp: Murmur checks at launch at most once per day. Downloads and installation remain your choice.
generalSettings.soundHelp: Play short chimes when dictation starts, ends, and if something didn't go through. Uses built-in system sounds and respects your volume.
generalSettings.muteHelp: Automatically mute system audio while a dictation is active — YouTube, Spotify, games, notifications. Restores when the dictation ends. Sound cues above keep playing either way.
generalSettings.microphoneHelp: Automatic uses your system default, but prefers USB microphones for Murmur when connected.
generalSettings.dictationRetentionHelp: Dictations older than this window are removed automatically. Shortening the window applies immediately after confirmation; individual entries cannot be exempted.
generalSettings.deleteDictationsHelp: Permanently delete every stored dictation transcript. Meeting captures, vocabulary, and corrections are not affected.
generalSettings.dictationsDeletedHelp: This permanently deletes every dictation transcript and resets the related totals on your Home dashboard.
generalSettings.otherDataSafe: Meeting captures, vocabulary, and corrections stay intact.
generalSettings.meetingRetentionHelp: Completed meetings older than this window are removed automatically. Shortening the window applies immediately after confirmation. Failed, interrupted, active, and processing meetings are kept.
generalSettings.audioRetentionHelp: Successful recordings stay local for a recovery grace period. Failed or interrupted audio is preserved until you retry, save a copy, or explicitly delete it.
generalSettings.deleteMeetingsHelp: Permanently delete stored meetings from Murmur, including retained meeting audio and recovery checkpoints. Active and processing meetings are left alone.
generalSettings.meetingsDeletedHelp: This permanently removes every stored meeting that is not active or processing, including failed or interrupted captures, retained audio, and recovery checkpoints.
generalSettings.savedCopiesSafe: Markdown or audio copies you saved elsewhere stay on disk.
generalSettings.aiPromptHelp: Used by Copy for AI. Murmur combines these instructions with the transcript on your clipboard so you can paste it into any AI assistant. Murmur does not send it anywhere.
generalSettings.aiPromptLanguageHelp: The default follows your App language. A saved custom prompt stays exactly as written when you change App language; restore the default to use the current App language.
generalSettings.restoreTitle: Restore the default AI handoff prompt?
generalSettings.restoreHelp: This replaces your saved instructions. The change affects future Copy for AI actions only.
generalSettings.meetingChangeHelp: Any completed meetings older than {period} will be permanently deleted immediately, including Murmur-owned retained audio and recovery checkpoints.
generalSettings.meetingChangeSafe: Failed, interrupted, active, and processing meetings stay in Murmur. Markdown or audio copies you saved elsewhere stay on disk.
generalSettings.dictationChangeHelp: Any existing dictations older than {period} will be permanently deleted immediately.
generalSettings.meetingsForeverToast: Meeting transcripts will be kept forever.
generalSettings.meetingsAfterToast: Meeting transcripts will be deleted after {period}.
